## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- The best fix is to rewrite the condition with explicit spacing (and optionally grouping) so the operator structure is visually clear while preserving exact logic.

In packages/runner/src/release-pipeline.ts, update the catch block condition at line 1245:

  • From: if(error instanceof EvidenceReadError&&error.status===404)return null;
  • To: if (error instanceof EvidenceReadError && error.status === 404) return null;

This keeps functionality identical and resolves the whitespace/precedence readability complaint. No imports, new methods, or definitions are required.
